name: Workflow E: Notification Digest & User Feedback Loop

parameters.query:
SELECT tr.id AS tailored_resume_id, tr.resume_version_id, tr.tailoring_summary,
       tr.docx_filename, tr.pdf_filename, tr.created_at AS tailored_at,
       jm.overall_match_score, jm.reasons_for_score, jm.missing_required_skills,
       jm.potential_eligibility_gaps, jm.recommendation,
       j.id AS job_uuid, j.title, j.company, j.location, j.work_mode,
       j.posted_at, j.application_url, j.first_seen_at,
       u.id AS user_id, u.email AS user_email, u.full_name,
       p.notification_method, p.notification_target
FROM tailored_resumes tr
JOIN job_matches jm ON jm.id = tr.job_match_id
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = tr.job_uuid
JOIN users u ON u.id = tr.user_id
JOIN user_preferences p ON p.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN notifications n
  ON n.tailored_resume_id = tr.id AND n.delivery_status = 'sent'
WHERE tr.qa_status = 'passed'
  AND n.id IS NULL
ORDER BY jm.overall_match_score DESC;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO application_tracking (
  user_id, job_uuid, tailored_resume_id, feedback_status, user_notes,
  approval_required, approved_for_submission
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, TRUE, FALSE
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, job_uuid) DO UPDATE SET
  feedback_status = EXCLUDED.feedback_status,
  user_notes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_notes, application_tracking.user_notes),
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, user_id, job_uuid, feedback_status, approval_required;
